spec.section: ## Trigger `lease_expires_at <= now`, a run has no report, or status reads `unknown`.

## Do
1. Write `capacity_lease_expired` and move the attempt to `paused:uncertain`; keep the reservation charged. 2. Probe in order: `GET /v1/runs/{run_id}`; `POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/resolve-unknown` with stored `admission_id` and `execution_generation`; session history for a correlated report. 3. Classify the result. `running` means renew/hold. A terminal run or matching terminal report permits a durable terminal manifest and release. `unreachable` or `unknown` means bounded retry, page and hold. 4. At the configured hold bound, an operator may release only through the explicit emergency authority path with reason, identity and audit evidence. Lease expiry alone never releases or marks terminal. 5. Only after reconciliation and an authorized new target decision may the logical send mint a successor attempt/key.

## Evidence Capture the lease event, every probe response, identity match, manifest revision, reservation decision and test `WF-07-LIVE-RUN-LEASE`. Expected live-run result: `paused:uncertain`, slot held, no duplicate POST.
